controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: Cassini 2012 mosaic, 293 m per source pixel, delivered on the shared 8192 × 4096 layout. Photographed shadows and variable resolution remain; globe Shadows add approximate lighting. Gray grid marks explicit source no-data. Mapped onto a simplified Cassini SPC shape; independent image control can leave local registration differences.
controls.summary: Source pixels span 293 m in the 2012 mosaic. Shadows and uneven detail remain; the gray grid marks missing observations.
controls.title: Global image mosaic

controls.label: Enhanced color
controls.description: Published 2014 infrared–green–ultraviolet composite, photometrically corrected by Paul Schenk. Enhanced colors extend beyond human vision. Source resolution varies; seams and residual photographed shading remain. Mapped onto a simplified Cassini SPC shape; independent image control can leave local registration differences.
controls.summary: Infrared, green and ultraviolet bands reveal colors beyond human vision. Detail varies; photographed shadows and seams remain.
controls.title: Enhanced-color composite

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Color shows height above the PDS 531 km reference sphere. Brightness shows fixed northwest relief lighting at true height scale; Shadows adds the shared approximate globe lighting. Cassini SPC model released in 2025, about 1.5 km grid spacing. The globe uses a simplified version of the released Q128 shape; grid and geometry resolutions differ. Model detail and accuracy vary.
controls.title: SPC terrain model

controls.label: Relative albedo
controls.description: Relative brightness solved together with the Cassini SPC shape model, normalized around 1. This secondary model product is less validated than topography. It is neither visible color nor calibrated reflectance. Colors show 0.5–1.5; values above 1.5 saturate. Gray grid preserves source gaps.
controls.title: SPC relative brightness model

controls.label: Shape
controls.description: Neutral grid over a simplified source shape, without photographic texture or height exaggeration. Source model detail and accuracy vary. Cassini SPC Q128 model released in 2025. The 2,000-face view retains broad shape; small terrain details are omitted.
controls.title: SPC shape model

controls.label: Infrared
controls.description: Seven Cassini VIMS observations from 2007–2015. False color assigns red to about 2.02 µm, green to 1.59 µm and blue to 1.28 µm. All three channels share a 0–0.65 I/F display range and gamma 2.2; this stretch changes the display only. No photometric correction is applied, so illumination remains. Archive noise filtering and local replacement are retained; original detector defects and potentially affected neighbors are excluded. Gray grid marks unsupported areas and scan gaps.
controls.summary: Cassini false color: red 2.02, green 1.59, blue 1.28 µm. Coverage is partial; gray grid marks gaps. Illumination and archive filtering remain in these uncorrected measurements.
controls.title: Cassini VIMS regional spectra · 2007–2015

controls.label: Ice absorption
controls.description: Near-2.02 µm water-ice band depth relative to a linear 1.82–2.20 µm continuum, using nine Cassini VIMS observations from 2007–2015. This measures absorption strength, not ice abundance. Viewing angle, grain size and noise also affect the values; no photometric correction is applied. Archive noise filtering and local replacement remain; original detector defects and potentially affected neighbors are excluded. Display colors saturate outside 0.55–0.75; original numerical values are retained. Gray grid marks unsupported areas and scan gaps.
controls.summary: Near-2.02 µm water-ice absorption in partial Cassini coverage. Gray grid marks gaps. Viewing angle, grain size, noise and archive filtering affect these uncorrected values; they do not measure ice abundance.
controls.title: Cassini VIMS regional water-ice absorption · 2007–2015
